heading: Form 146 for Foreign Remittances: CA Certificate & Filing Guide
tldr: Form 146 is a Chartered Accountant (CA) certified document required for specific foreign remittances from India.
Its primary purpose is to help determine the taxability and applicable Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on overseas payments.
This form becomes mandatory when the nature of the foreign remittance is taxable and exceeds certain prescribed thresholds.
Taxpayers need to obtain this certificate from a CA and submit it to their bank before initiating the remittance.
Proper filing of Form 146 ensures compliance with income tax regulations and avoids potential penalties.
caption:
Sending money abroad from India? If you're paying for certain things overseas, you might need a special certificate from a CA. This helps make sure you pay the right taxes and avoid problems later. It's important to understand when this applies to you. Learn more about Form 146 and how it keeps your money transfers smooth and compliant in our full article.
